_doc: Dạng kịch bản (narrative) — xoay vòng theo video như style/giọng (vidlib/narratives.py). Mỗi dạng: name (tiếng Việt, cho người làm), shape (tiếng Anh, cho LLM viết kịch bản), visual (tiếng Anh: hình cho ngày code + ngày Flow), tags (chủ đề hợp, so cả dạng gốc của từ), strong (regex trên ý tưởng → +3 điểm, được phép dù vừa dùng: tiêu đề '5 things…' bắt buộc phải đếm ngược), moves (kiểu bay camera spine ưa dùng — giao với ngữ pháp camera của look, rỗng = theo look), base (điểm nền).

classic.name: Thí nghiệm kinh điển (mở → leo thang → bước ngoặt)
classic.shape: Experiment arc: cold-open on the paradox in motion → setup shows the baseline → each beat pivots via But/Therefore causality (never linear 'and then') → mid-video re-hook at 12–16s flips the angle → payoff (the measured result) → twist (one ironic line set up earlier).
classic.visual: Mix 3D `stage` camera angles with cinema 2D beats (`xray_cutaway`, `dossier`, `hero_stat`); save the biggest `hero_stat` number for the payoff.

countdown.name: Đếm ngược top N
countdown.shape: Countdown: the hook promises four or five surprising effects and teases number one without revealing it. Then count DOWN: each item is one stage ('Number five: …') with one fact and one consequence, each stronger than the last. Number one is the payoff; the twist follows it.
countdown.visual: Every item opens on its number: `kicker: "#5"` (code day: `counter` with layout `giant`, `fact` with layout `stamp`, or a `scene` acting the item out; Flow day: a text_fx `#5` badge). The items must look different from each other — never the same card five times.

timeline.name: Theo đồng hồ (từng phút / từng giờ)
timeline.shape: Clock: walk through time in fixed jumps (seconds, minutes, hours, days or years — whatever fits the topic). Each stage opens on the time ('Minute ten.', 'Hour six.') and escalates pressure via But/Therefore causality. The jumps may grow (one minute → ten minutes → one hour → one day). The last stop is the payoff; the twist reframes the whole timeline.
timeline.visual: Use persistent top-level `story_hud` (clock/temp/bpm) across every shot alongside `xray_cutaway`, `graph`, or 3D `dolly_zoom` as the clock visibly advances. Flow day: a text_fx time stamp on every stage.

myth_fact.name: Lật tẩy hiểu lầm (myth vs fact)
myth_fact.shape: Myth vs fact: the hook states the belief everybody holds, as if it were true — then interrupts it abruptly (`tape_stop`) with counter-evidence. Bust it in But/Therefore rounds: the myth → the test or evidence → the real mechanism with one number. The payoff is what really happens; the twist is the hidden detail that makes the truth stranger.
myth_fact.visual: Make every verdict visible: `dossier` with `stamp` (BUSTED / VERIFIED), `hero_stat`, `xray_cutaway` for the real mechanism, `compare` with layout `split`, or 3D `low_hero`. Flow day: text_fx stamps MYTH / FACT over the test.

escalation.name: Phóng đại ×10 mỗi bước
escalation.shape: Times ten: run the same experiment at one, then ten, a hundred, a thousand… (or divide by ten going small). Each step is one stage: the new amount → what changes → one number. Keep going until something absurd or a hard limit — the breaking point is the payoff. The twist brings it back to human scale.
escalation.visual: Each step must feel like a jump in scale: a `scale` beat, `counter` with layout `bar`, a `scene` with more and more copies of the object; the one-take camera dives into the object between steps. Flow day: identical framing, more and more of the object each clip.

journey.name: Hành trình của một vật
journey.shape: Journey: follow ONE thing from start to end — a sip of water through the body, a photon from the sun, a coin through the economy. Narrate its route stop by stop ('First it hits… then… by the time it reaches…'). Each stop is one stage with one fact. The destination is the payoff; the twist is where it really ends up or how long it really took.
journey.visual: The traveller is the SAME object in every shot (same icon or actor) moving through changing surroundings: a `scene` with the object as the actor moving along `keys`, `process` with layout `path`, `callout` labelling where it is now. Flow day: the same object in every start frame (ingredients).

versus.name: Đối đầu A vs B
versus.shape: Versus: two contenders (two objects, two strategies, two animals…). Introduce both in the hook. Then two or three rounds, each one measurable test with a winner and a running score. An upset in the last round; the payoff names the winner; the twist says why the loser still matters (or the hidden cost of winning).
versus.visual: Keep both contenders on screen together: `compare` with layout `split` or `balance`, a `scene` with both actors racing, the running score in the `kicker` ("ROUND 2 · 1–0"). Flow day: mirror-composed frames, contender A always on the left.

rewind.name: Mở bằng kết cục rồi tua lại
rewind.shape: Rewind: open on the final outcome — the most extreme moment — as the hook. Then rewind to zero ('Let's go back.') and walk forward fast through three or four stages that explain how it got there. The payoff catches up with the opening image; the twist reveals the detail the opening hid.
rewind.visual: Shot 1 and the payoff show the SAME image (the payoff with more context). Mark the rewind visibly: a `title` with kicker "REWIND" or a `scene` played backwards (keys reversed), then forward stages with step kickers. Flow day: the payoff clip reuses the hook's start frame.

chain_reaction.name: Phản ứng dây chuyền (domino)
chain_reaction.shape: Chain reaction: one small trigger → domino one → domino two → domino three, each caused by the last ('…which means… which means…'). The tipping point is the payoff; the twist is how small the trigger was.
chain_reaction.visual: Show causality on screen: a `scene` with `arrows` from one actor to the next, `process` with layout `path`; every new shot starts from the last object of the previous one (the one-take camera carries it across). Flow day: each clip's start frame is the previous clip's end state.

mystery.name: Bí ẩn có lời giải
mystery.shape: Mystery: open with a strange documented fact that seems impossible. Offer the intuitive guess and kill it via But/Therefore evidence. Zoom into the real cause clue by clue (evidence → re-hook reversal → mechanism). The payoff is the mechanism; the twist adds the one detail that makes it even stranger.
mystery.visual: Archival clues and close-ups: `dossier` cards with highlighted evidence, `xray_cutaway` for the hidden mechanism, 3D `low_hero` spotlight reveals. Flow day: macro close-ups, one clue per clip.
